get.summary: Get subset of runtime data log history according to query/filter parameters.

parameters.name: sortProperty
parameters.description: The RuntimeInfo property name to sort the run history records by (simple properties only, cannot sort by instrument list). Hamilton.WebAPI.Common.RuntimeInfo

parameters.name: sortOrder
parameters.description: Chronological ordering of run history records returned. Hamilton.WebAPI.Common.Ordering

parameters.name: startOffset
parameters.description: Starting record number (one-based indexing). Default is one.

parameters.name: recordLimit
parameters.description: Limit of records to download. Default is fifty.  For pagination support.

parameters.name: startDateRange
parameters.description: Datestamp for start of range of records to be returned.

parameters.name: endDateRange
parameters.description: Datestamp for end of range of records to be returned.

parameters.name: runState
parameters.description: If supplied the records returned will all match this run state.
